name: Tideward
summary: Tideward is a single-player idle RPG in the RuneScape and Melvor Idle lineage. Players train 28 trades across combat, gathering, artisan and wayfaring, among them Fishing, Mining, Cooking and Shipwrighting, and fight with melee, ranged and magic. Progress continues for up to 24 hours while the game is closed. It runs natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro and Apple Watch; an Android version is in open beta on Google Play, and a Windows PC version for Steam is in development. The game was called Manu Idle until May 2026.
